$comment: Production npm dependencies whose licence is not one of MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, ISC. Each entry needs a justification and a review status. 'pending-human-review' entries pre-date the gate and are listed in docs/STATUS.md under 'Licence questions'; they must not be copied as precedent for new dependencies.

exceptions.justification: Transitive (glob via archiver/jest tooling chain). BlueOak Model License 1.0.0 is a permissive licence (OSI-approved), not on the policy's five-licence list.
Transitive (glob/path-scurry). Permissive, OSI-approved; not on the five-licence list.
Transitive (glob). Permissive, OSI-approved; not on the five-licence list.
Transitive (glob). Permissive, OSI-approved; not on the five-licence list.
Transitive (xml2js via onvif). sax 1.6 moved from ISC to BlueOak-1.0.0.
Transitive (TypeScript runtime helpers). 0BSD is public-domain-equivalent, more permissive than MIT.
Transitive (pdfkit). Zlib licence is permissive (attribution in source only).
Transitive (pdfkit). package.json declares no licence; the shipped LICENSE file is the MIT text (checked 2026-09-27). Needs confirmation by a human.
